oath-of-the-noble-genies.summary: A Paladin sworn to the four genie lords of the Elemental Planes, wielding earth, air, fire and water through their smites.

Elemental Smite.summary: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend a Channel Divinity use for one genie effect: grapple and restrain the target, teleport and turn semi-incorporeal, spread 2d4 Fire to a second creature, or knock foes back and Prone.

options.name: Dao’s Crush
options.summary: The target is Grappled (escape DC = your spell save DC) and Restrained while Grappled.

options.name: Djinni’s Escape
options.summary: Teleport up to 30 ft to a space you see; until the end of your next turn, resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing and ignore Grappled, Prone and Restrained.

options.name: Efreeti’s Fury
options.summary: The target takes an extra 2d4 Fire, and another creature you see within 30 ft takes 2d4 Fire too.

options.name: Marid’s Surge
options.summary: The target and chosen creatures in a 10-ft Emanation make a STR save; on a failure they're pushed 15 ft away and knocked Prone.

Genie Spells.summary: Always prepared: Chromatic Orb, Elementalism and Thunderous Smite at Paladin 3; Mirror Image and Phantasmal Force at 5; Fly and Gaseous Form at 9; Conjure Minor Elementals and Summon Elemental at 13; Banishing Smite and Contact Other Plane at 17.

Genie’s Splendor.summary: Unarmored AC is 10 + DEX + CHA, and a Shield still stacks. Gain one of Acrobatics, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion.

Aura of Elemental Shielding.summary: You and allies in your Aura of Protection resist one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder; you can switch the type at the start of each of your turns.

Elemental Rebuke.summary: Reaction when an attack roll hits you: halve its damage and the attacker makes a DEX save, taking 2d10 + CHA Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (half on a success). CHA modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Noble Scion.summary: Bonus Action: for 10 minutes gain a 60-ft Fly Speed with hover, and by Reaction turn a failed D20 Test into a success for you or an ally within your Aura of Protection. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Fly Speed 60 ft; you can hover.

options.name: Minor Wish
options.summary: Reaction when you, or an ally within your Aura of Protection, fail a D20 Test: it becomes a success.
